title: People’s Mañanera August 5
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexico Organizes to Plant Life  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum called for "setting aside one day a year when
we all engage in reforesting," in presenting the National Reforestation Day.
On August 9, about 235,000 people will plant 6.6 million trees and plants
across the country, with the goal of reforesting and conserving 1.5 billion
plants and trees by 2030.

**#MiercolesDeVivienda From Querétaro  
** The President highlighted progress in the housing program. "It is changing
the reality of many families," Governor Mauricio Kuri acknowledged. Querétaro
has 16,740 homes under construction, and nationwide more than 33,000 homes
have already been assigned. In addition, 14 new housing developments will be
inaugurated in August.

**INE Budget Is Excessive  
** Sheinbaum called the National Electoral Institute's (INE) request for an
additional 15 billion pesos (US$860 million) for the 2027 elections
"excessive". "It should cost practically the same as the 2024 election,
considering only inflation (as a factor)," the President said, noting that the
2024 elections were actually more expensive because they included both the
presidential and legislative races.

**Audience Rights: More Rights for Citizens  
** The President explained that the new guidelines strengthen audience rights
and the right of reply. "All they stipulate is (that the media must) issue
their code of ethics, appoint their audience ombudsman, and set up a mechanism
so that viewers and listeners can file complaints," she explained. The
proposal remains under public consultation so that comments can be
incorporated in the final version.

**Sheinbaum Exposes the Right-Wing 's Contradiction  
**The President recalled that opposition aligned journalist and political
analyst Sergio Sarmiento said 26 years ago, and still says today, that "the
media deliberately lies" and that legislation should exist for defense against
defamation. "And what does that mean? Audience rights," Sheinbaum said in
reply, pointing out the contradiction of those who now charge censorship in
relation to a proposal that they themselves defended decades ago.

**The Morning Press Conference Informs the People Transparently  
** The President reaffirmed that the morning press conference guarantees the
right to information and responds to misinformation with facts. Sheinbaum
noted that official advertising is now distributed using objective criteria,
with spending equal to one-third of what was allocated during Peña Nieto
administration, with public and state media being prioritized.

**Lie Detector**

  * It is not true that the Guidelines for the Protection of Audience Rights seek to censor the media.
  * It is not true that the State will determine what is true and what is not true.
  * It is not true that the Government will sanction media content.
  * It is not true that a notification will be placed every time an opinion is expressed.
  * It is not true that the Well-Being budget will allocate 83 million pesos (US$4.77 billion) for "food for meetings."
  * It is not true that a "clandestine refinery" dedicated to illegal fuel processing was found in Coatepec, Veracruz.
  * It is not true that Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) profits fell 31.7%.
  * It is not true that Chapultepec Castle was rented as a venue for a private wedding.
